versions.changelog: The description now names the real default: embeddings run fully local through the local Nexus service (sentence-transformers with Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, 1024d); a cloud embedder runs only when NEXUS_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER names one together with its key. Version 0.1.5.

Corrections now reach the keyword index: updating a memory replaces its old text there, so a fact no longer stays findable by the wording you just refuted (fix landed in the Nexus engine, v0.22.7). The 'Manual Tools' section documents it.

Embeddings now default to the LOCAL provider (Ollama, qwen3-embedding:0.6b) - no API key or cloud account needed out of the box. Cloud (Voyage) is now an explicit opt-in. Also: session-start hook gained a local embedding path (previously cloud-only), docs rewritten around the local default.

Docs corrected: embedding default is Voyage (cloud) not local; corrected env var defaults; new section on data storage, disabling auto-capture, shared collections (addresses ClawHub security findings).

Docs corrected: embedding default is Voyage (cloud) not local; corrected env var defaults; new section on data storage, disabling auto-capture, shared collections (addresses ClawHub security findings).

- Initial release of persistent memory for Claude Code using Qdrant.
- Auto-Recall: Injects relevant memories from Qdrant before each prompt.
- Auto-Capture: Stores extracted facts after every user interaction.
- Session Start: Loads project-related memories at session begin or resume.
- Supports manual tools: remember, recall, and forget.
- Shares a Qdrant memory store with Hermes Agent and OpenClaw for unified, cross-agent memory.
- Fully configurable via NEXUS_* environment variables.
